The name Jemimah is an etymological equivalent of the Latin word 'somnium.' In Christian tradition, the name Jemimah appears to be not a biblical name, but might be an inspired name from the Hebrew scripture, which speaks of a dream and rest. In English, the name Jemimah is a feminine name, which means 'to sleep, to rest, a dream.'
